risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and highly quantified, reporting sales, profit, restructuring, pension, tax, and impairment effects. Forward-looking risks include deteriorating plasticizer demand, regulatory-driven volume declines, competitive pricing pressure, and reliance on successful facility conversion and cost savings. The tone is cautiously positive because profitability improved materially, but earnings quality is affected by divestitures, pension gains, tax benefits, and restructuring actions.
